title: In silico simulations and molecular descriptors to predict in vitro transactivation potencies of Baikal seal estrogen receptors by environmental contaminants.
authors: Nguyen, Hoa Thanh; Yoshinouchi, Yuka; Hirano, Masashi; Nomiyama, Kei; Nakata, Haruhiko; Kim, Eun-Young; Iwata, Hisato
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和QSAR预测环境污染物对贝加尔海豹雌激素受体的转录激活效力，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合建模，但对象为核受体与小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Baikal seals (Pusa sibirica) are vulnerable to high levels of organic pollutants. Here, we evaluated the transactivation potencies of bisphenols (BPs) and hydroxylated polychlorinated biphenyls (OH-PCBs) via the Baikal seal estrogen receptor alpha and beta (bsERalpha and bsERbeta) using in vitro and in silico approaches. In vitro reporter gene assays showed that most BPs and OH-PCBs exhibited estrogenic activity with bsER sub-type-specific potency. Among the BPs tested, bisphenol AF showed the lowest EC(50) for both bsERs. 4'-OH-CB50 and 4'-OH-CB30 showed the lowest EC(50) among OH-PCBs tested for bsERalpha and bsERbeta, respectively. 4-((4-Isopropoxyphenyl)-sulfonyl)phenol, 4'-OH-CB72, and 4'-OH-CB121 showed weak bsERalpha-specific transactivation. Only 4-OH-CB107 did not affect both bsERs. In silico docking simulations revealed the binding affinities of these chemicals to bsERs and partially explained the in vitro results. Using the in silico simulations and molecular descriptors as explanatory variables and the in vitro results as objective variables, the quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) models constructed for classification and regression accurately separated bsER-active compounds from non-active compounds and predicted the in vitro bsERalpha- and bsERbeta-transactivation potencies, respectively. The QSAR models also suggested that chemical polarity, van der Waals surface area, bridging atom structure, position of the phenolic-OH group, and ligand interactions with key residues of the ligand binding pocket are critical variables to account for the bsER transactivation potency of the test compounds. We also succeeded in constructing computational models for predicting in vitro transactivation potencies of mouse ERs in the same manner, demonstrating the applicability of our approach independent of species-specific responses.
abstract_zh: 贝加尔海豹（Pusa sibirica）易受高浓度有机污染物的影响。在此，我们通过体外和计算机模拟方法，评估了双酚类化合物（BPs）和羟基化多氯联苯（OH-PCBs）经由贝加尔海豹雌激素受体α和β（bsERalpha和bsERbeta）的反式激活效力。体外报告基因实验显示，大多数BPs和OH-PCBs表现出具有bsER亚型特异性效力的雌激素活性。在测试的BPs中，双酚AF对两种bsERs均显示出最低的EC(50)。在测试的OH-PCBs中，4'-OH-CB50和4'-OH-CB30分别对bsERalpha和bsERbeta显示出最低的EC(50)。4-((4-异丙氧基苯基)磺酰基)苯酚、4'-OH-CB72和4'-OH-CB121显示出弱的bsERalpha特异性反式激活。仅4-OH-CB107对两种bsERs均无影响。计算机模拟对接实验揭示了这些化学物质与bsERs的结合亲和力，并部分解释了体外实验结果。利用计算机模拟和分子描述符作为解释变量，体外实验结果作为目标变量，构建的分类和回归定量构效关系（QSAR）模型分别准确区分了bsER活性化合物与非活性化合物，并预测了体外bsERalpha和bsERbeta的反式激活效力。QSAR模型还表明，化学极性、范德华表面积、桥接原子结构、酚羟基位置以及配体与配体结合口袋关键残基的相互作用是解释测试化合物bsER反式激活效力的关键变量。我们还以相同方式成功构建了预测小鼠ERs体外反式激活效力的计算模型，证明了我们的方法在不同物种特异性反应中的适用性。
